focus: Canonicalize the interaction-response flag cleared by the runtime Type-0x80/0x87 spawn handler.
contracts: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType87_80 clears byte 0x00FFF104 before entering InteractionSpawn_ReverseSlot.
The target uses ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_87_INTERACTION_RESPONSE at 0x001B7C4C and the reverse-slot actor allocator family.
The current whole-ROM reference set exports no direct reader or additional writer for 0x00FFF104.
conclusion: The byte is a canonical interaction-response flag with a deliberately limited clear-only contract.
